hotel.eventDescription: One Agoda property's cheapest rate for your dates and guests (row keys hotel_id, hotel_name, stars, review_score, review_count, area, country, latitude, longitude, price_nightly, price_nightly_with_taxes, price_total, price_total_with_taxes, crossed_out_price, available_rooms, cancellation, free_cancellation_until, breakfast_included): $4 per 1,000 hotels. Not charged: sold-out properties (free rows with includeSoldOut), properties maxPrice, minStars, minReviewScore or freeCancellationOnly remove, a property reached twice in one run, destinations or names that match nothing, status rows, bad input. No start fee; proxy and compute are included in the event price. The run stops at the maximum cost per run you set when starting it (Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd), never above it.

calendar_day.eventDescription: One check-in date of a named hotel's price calendar (calendarDays, up to 60 dates from checkIn): per-night and stay price at your nights and adults priced live for that date, rank_in_window (1 = the cheapest date), Agoda's Low/Normal/High trend word where it has one (row keys hotel_id, hotel_name, check_in, check_out, nights, adults, currency, price_nightly, price_total, trend, rank_in_window, cheapest_in_window): $2 per 1,000 dates. Not charged: dates Agoda has no price for (skipped), hotels from destination searches (no calendar is read for them), bad input. No start fee; the same maximum-cost stop applies.
